name: vegasslotsonline
prehideSelectors: div.fixed:has(> div > p > a[href*='/cookies/']):has(> div > button)

detectCmp.exists: div.fixed:has(> div > p > a[href*='/cookies/']):has(> div > button)

detectPopup.visible: div.fixed:has(> div > p > a[href*='/cookies/']):has(> div > button)

optIn.waitForThenClick: div.fixed:has(> div > p > a[href*='/cookies/']) > div:last-child > button:last-child

optOut.waitForThenClick: div.fixed:has(> div > p > a[href*='/cookies/']) > div:last-child > button:first-child
